claims.text: The resort sits in a clifftop setting about an hour outside the ancient city of Nizwa.

findings.quote: Alila Jabal Akhdar is perfectly camouflaged into its clifftop setting just an hour outside the ancient city of Nizwa.
findings.note: Establishes both the clifftop setting and the one-hour distance from Nizwa.

claims.text: Locally sourced materials and classic-style stonework are combined with contemporary architecture.

findings.quote: Locally sourced materials and classic-style stonework combine with contemporary architecture to create a truly unique setting

claims.text: The suites and villas are built from mountain stone and adorned with hand-painted juniper leaves by local artists.

findings.quote: Built from mountain stone and adorned with hand-painted juniper leaves by local artists, each space blends heritage, sustainability, and modern elegance
findings.note: Refers to the 86 suites and villas.

claims.text: Rooms have built-in fireplaces.

findings.quote: Woven rugs and hand-painted juniper leaf murals supply a dose of warmth, as do built-in fireplaces.
findings.note: The editorial review mentions built-in fireplaces in the rooms.

claims.text: The spa fuses time-honored Asian healing practices with traditional beauty formulas crafted from natural elements.

findings.quote: Immerse yourself in the fusion of time-honored Asian healing practices and traditional beauty formulas crafted from natural elements

claims.text: The resort's garden is home to one of Oman's first high-altitude hydroponic systems in a luxury resort.

findings.quote: you’ll begin your culinary journey in Alila’s thriving garden—home to one of Oman's first high-altitude hydroponic systems in a luxury resort.

claims.text: A mountain-to-table cooking experience has guests cook traditional Omani dishes over open flame in an outdoor kitchen.

findings.quote: Then step into our outdoor kitchen, where you’ll learn to craft traditional Omani dishes using open flame, local spice and time-honored technique.
findings.note: Part of the From Earth to Flame mountain-to-table experience.

claims.text: An excursion to Nizwa takes in its markets, its fort and the ancient alleys of Birkat Almouz.

findings.quote: From its buzzing markets and storied fort to the ancient alleys of Birkat Almouz, this is history not as lecture, but as living conversation.
findings.note: Covers the markets, the fort and Birkat Almouz on the Nizwa journey.

claims.text: A via ferrata climbing path is located just beyond the hotel restaurant.

findings.quote: the unique via ferrata climbing path, located just beyond the hotel restaurant

claims.text: Complimentary activities rotate and include sunrise or sunset yoga on a platform overlooking the mountains.

findings.quote: check out the rotating list of complimentary activities, including sunrise or sunset yoga set on a platform overlooking the mountains.

claims.text: Juniper restaurant, named after the juniper trees of Oman's highlands, uses fresh, seasonal local produce.

findings.quote: Named after the juniper trees that grow in the highlands of Oman, Juniper Restaurant offers a rich variety of flavours using fresh and seasonal local produce crafted to gastronomic perfection.
findings.note: Covers both the origin of the name and the use of produce.

claims.text: Most of the front office staff are local Omanis who live in nearby villages.

findings.quote: Most of the front office staff are local Omani and live in nearby villages

claims.text: The resort is perched more than 6,500 feet above sea level amid an alpine landscape dominated by Jabal Akhdar, the Green Mountain.

findings.quote: Perched more than 6,500 feet above sea level, this luxury resort sits amid an alpine landscape dominated by Jabal Akhdar itself, which translates to “Green Mountain” in Arabic.
findings.note: Covers the altitude, the alpine landscape and the Green Mountain translation.

claims.text: The design takes inspiration from the region's ancient forts, using traditional building techniques, fort-like doors, wooden rafters and Omani design motifs.

findings.quote: Alila Jabal Akhdar takes inspiration from the ancient forts in the region using traditional building techniques, fort-like doors, wooden rafters and Omani design motifs

claims.text: A signature wellness experience includes a Balinese massage in a spa pavilion overlooking the canyon, beneath open sky.

findings.quote: Arrive at the spa pavilion overlooking the canyon and enjoy a personalized Balinese massage beneath open sky.
findings.note: Part of the Heart of the Mountain wellness Alila Moment.

claims.text: Clear skies make stargazing a highlight.

findings.quote: Clear skies in a majestic setting make stargazing a must
findings.note: The page calls stargazing "a must"; I treated this as equivalent to a highlight.

claims.text: The resort has an expansive infinity pool with views of the Green Mountain and a heated indoor pool.

findings.quote: Take in views of majestic Green Mountain from our expansive infinity pool or opt for the serenity and privacy of our heated indoor pool.

claims.text: The property is remote, with not much around it, and the drive from Muscat takes about 2.5 hours.

findings.quote: This is a remote property, with not a whole lot around—but that’s the entire point, right?
we’re talking about a 2.5-hour journey from Muscat by car.

claims.text: A 4x4 vehicle is mandatory for the mountain road.

findings.quote: (While steep, it’s a relatively straightforward drive, but a 4x4 vehicle is mandatory.)

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited dining and entertainment options nearby.
